about.title: About Us
about.introText: At Zahi, we believe shopping should be an enjoyable and easy experience. Our store was founded to offer the best authentic fashion products at the best prices, with fast and reliable delivery across Egypt.
about.missionText: To provide an exceptional online shopping experience by offering high-quality products at competitive prices, ensuring customer satisfaction, and providing the best after-sales services.
about.visionText: To become the premier destination for online shopping in Egypt and the Arab region, and be the optimal choice for those seeking quality and trust.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions
faq.q1a: Delivery takes 3 to 7 business days depending on the area. Greater Cairo takes 3 to 5 days, and other governorates take 5 to 7 days.
faq.q2a: Yes, you can return the product within 14 days of receipt, provided it is in its original condition and unused. The full amount will be refunded within 5 business days.
faq.q3a: We offer several payment methods: cash on delivery, credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), and direct bank transfer.
faq.q4a: Yes, we offer free shipping for orders over 500 EGP. For lower orders, a shipping fee of 30 EGP applies.
faq.q5: How can I track my order?
faq.q5a: You can track your order through your account on the website, where you'll find all preparation and shipping stages. We will also send notifications and emails about your order status.
faq.q6: Are the products authentic and guaranteed?
faq.q6a: Yes, all products in our store are 100% authentic and guaranteed. We offer products from trusted global brands with quality assurance.
faq.q7: How can I contact customer service?
faq.q7a: You can contact us via the Contact Us page on the website, or by email at info@zahi.store, or by phone at +20 123 456 7890 from Saturday to Thursday from 9 AM to 10 PM.
faq.q8: Can I cancel my order after confirmation?
faq.q8a: You can cancel the order within 24 hours of confirmation. After that, if preparation has begun, we may not be able to cancel. Please contact customer service for assistance.
faq.q9a: We are committed to protecting your data privacy. All personal information is encrypted and protected. We will not share your data with any third party without your consent.
faq.q10: Can I change the delivery address after ordering?
faq.q10a: Yes, you can change the delivery address before the order is shipped. Please contact customer service as soon as possible to update the address.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Zahi, we are committed to protecting the privacy of our visitors and customers. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the personal information you provide when using our website.
privacy.section1Content: We may collect the following types of information:
privacy.section1Item1: Personal information: name, email, phone number, delivery address
privacy.section1Item2: Payment information: credit card data (processed securely through a certified payment gateway)
privacy.section1Item3: Browsing information: IP address, browser type, pages visited, browsing duration
privacy.section1Item4: Order history: purchased products, amounts, order dates
privacy.section2Content: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
privacy.section2Item2: Communicating with you about your orders and inquiries
privacy.section2Item3: Improving our services and user experience
privacy.section2Item4: Sending promotional offers and updates (with your consent)
privacy.section3Content: We use advanced security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, modification, or disclosure. These measures include encryption, firewalls, and SSL security protocols.
privacy.section4Content: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes without your consent. We may share information with delivery partners and payment services solely to fulfill your orders.
privacy.section5Content: We use cookies to improve your browsing experience, personalize content, and analyze traffic. You can control cookie settings through your browser settings.
privacy.section6Item1: Access and correct your personal data
privacy.section6Item2: Request deletion of your personal data
privacy.section6Item3: Object to the processing of your data
privacy.section7Content: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by email or through a notice on our website.
privacy.section8Content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at: info@zahi.store

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Please read these terms and conditions carefully before using the Zahi website. By using the website, you agree to be bound by these terms.
terms.section1Content: By using our website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any of these terms, please do not use the website.
terms.section2Item1: You must be 18 years of age or older to create an account
terms.section2Item2: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account information
terms.section2Item3: You must provide accurate and complete information when registering
terms.section2Item4: We reserve the right to suspend or cancel accounts that violate terms
terms.section3Item1: We reserve the right to modify prices at any time without prior notice
terms.section3Item2: The order is confirmed after payment or payment method confirmation
terms.section3Item3: We reserve the right to refuse any order for any reason
terms.section4Item1: We deliver to all Egyptian governorates
terms.section4Item2: Delivery time is 3-7 business days depending on the area
terms.section4Item3: Delivery fee is 30 EGP for orders under 500 EGP
terms.section4Item4: Free delivery for orders exceeding 500 EGP
terms.section5Item1: Products can be returned within 14 days of receipt
terms.section5Item2: Products must be in their original condition with original packaging
terms.section5Item3: Personal and intimate items cannot be returned for health reasons
terms.section5Item4: Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days after receiving the returned product
terms.section6Content: All content on this website, including text, images, logos, and software, is owned by Zahi or licensed to us, and is protected by intellectual property laws. No content may be copied, distributed, or used without prior written permission.
terms.section7Content: We shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use our website or products. Our maximum liability is the value of the purchased product.
terms.section8Content: We reserve the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. You will be notified of material changes by email or through a notice on the website. Your continued use of the website after modifications constitutes your acceptance of the modified terms.
terms.section9Content: These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt. Any dispute arising from these terms shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Egyptian courts.
terms.section10Content: For any inquiries regarding these terms and conditions, please contact us at: info@zahi.store

testimonials.customer1Comment: Zahi store is my first choice for elegance. I ordered a suit and it arrived on time with luxurious packaging. Very high quality. I recommend everyone to shop here.
testimonials.customer2Comment: My first time ordering from Zahi and I was hesitant, but the experience was amazing. The dress was even more beautiful than the pictures! Fast and professional customer service. I'll definitely order again.
testimonials.customer3Comment: Zahi is the best online clothing store in Egypt. Competitive prices and 100% authentic products. Easy-to-use website and fast delivery.
testimonials.customer4Comment: I've shopped from Zahi many times and I'm always happy. Wide selection, high quality, fast delivery, and the products are exactly as described. Thank you Zahi!
testimonials.customer5Comment: The best online clothing store in Egypt. Real warranty and excellent after-sales service. Elegance that adorns you indeed! Very happy with my dealings with them.
